about: I am a computational linguist and computer scientist working on language technology for low-resource South Asian languages, with a particular focus on Tamil and Sinhala. My research spans linguistic resource creation, morphology and syntax, Universal Dependencies and Lexical-Functional Grammar, speech and text corpora, OCR, text-to-speech, language-model evaluation, and culturally grounded language technologies. I also bring a systems-engineering background in DNS, mail, web, LDAP, networking and learning-management infrastructure, which shapes my interest in practical, sustainable and openly usable research systems.
